newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy MIF futures market to modify entry rules.
newsitem.headline: Italy MIF futures market to modify entry rules.

text.p: Principal operators on the Italian futures market (MIF) will have to conform to more selective criteria if they want to remain on the market, the government bond secondary market (MTS) and MIF management committee announced.
They also said that from April, dealers will be able to quote prices.
The two changes are contained in a ministerial decree in response to a request by the MTS/MIF management committee.
Market operators will be selected by the Bank of Italy based on activity carried out for their own account on the futures market between March 6 and June 6 this year.
No further details were immediately available.
